summary: Settled the OTel/events.jsonl join precisely (new nullable cc_session_id + cwd fields, captured from already-parsed hook stdin, exact join on cc_session_id), mapped the four-tier source model onto all 12 /distill sub-modes, confirmed 873's cd mechanism fully covers the memory/event scripts given the existing relative-path invocation convention, and designed the skill-learn/skill-distill split with a contiguous, skeleton-factored skill-distill layout. Research only -- no files written outside specs/887_.../.

artifacts.summary: Research report: telemetry source architecture and /distill redesign

research_decisions: OTel/events.jsonl join: add nullable cc_session_id (Claude Code's native UUIDv4) and cwd fields to events-schema.json, captured from hook stdin already parsed by events-log-lifecycle.sh and events-log-artifact.sh (both currently discard these fields). Exact join on cc_session_id; cwd is the secondary correlator and repo-tag source. This is a deliberate, non-silent schema revision (top-level additionalProperties: false).
gen_ai.* names are borrowed only as literal keys inside the already-open `detail` object when citing OTel evidence -- never as new top-level snake_case-violating field names.

873's cd "$GLOBAL_ROOT" mechanism fully resolves cross-repo access for memory-retrieve.sh/memory-harvest.sh/events-query.sh/events-append.sh with NO script changes needed, because every existing call site already uses the relative-path form `bash .claude/scripts/{name}.sh` -- confirmed across all 13 call sites. New --meta/--revise/--review call sites must follow the same chained cd + relative-path discipline, never an absolute path or a distant cd.

--revise and --meta are the current dream sub-mode's two existing halves (lines 2102-2271 and 2273-2325 of skill-memory/SKILL.md), renamed and extended -- not new machinery. --dream is redefined to source from history.jsonl for speculative direction-finding only. --review is the one sub-mode spanning all four tiers live, read-only. --learn sources Tier 4 (30-day transcripts) falling back to Tier 3 (history.jsonl) for older archived tasks.
The six existing hygiene sub-modes (report/purge/merge/compress/refine/gc/auto) get zero source changes, per the binding no-new-hygiene-below-~100-entries constraint.

skill-memory/SKILL.md splits at its existing '## Mode: distill' boundary (line 1063) into skill-learn and skill-distill; skill-distill is additionally reordered to contiguous sub-mode sections (purge immediately followed by its logical pair gc) and factored around one shared 7-step skeleton section.
residual_risks: --meta's events.jsonl signal is single-repo only (no cross-repo event aggregation exists) -- must be documented as a scope limit, not solved in this task.
The events-schema.json revision is breaking-adjacent for any strict external validator; both new fields are nullable/optional but this must be an explicit implementation-plan checklist item.

--revise's OTel evidence tier silently contributes nothing if CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY is unset in the user's environment; must degrade via the same explicitly-announced degraded-path pattern the current dream section already uses for 'No Events Yet'.
